newsitem.title: USA: DenAmerica completes sale of restaurants.
newsitem.headline: DenAmerica completes sale of restaurants.

text.p: DenAmerica Corp, a restaurant franchisor, on Tuesday said it sold 11 Mr. Fable's restaurants, located in Western Michigan, to a private investor group for cash and notes.
Financial terms of the sale were not disclosed.

"The sale of the Mr. Fable's restaurants is consistent with our ongoing strategy of focusing on the Denny's and Black-eyed Pea restaurant concepts," Chief Executive Officer Jack Lloyd said in a statement.

Following the sale, DenAmerica operates 15 restaurants that are not one of the two concepts, down from 82 in March 1996. The company expects to convert these remaining restaurants to either the Denny's or Black-eyed Pea concepts by the end of the year, it said.
